messages:
Elaine (Support): heads up — customer reported intermittent 502s from hosted API when calling /v1/generate. Starts around ~12:02 UTC, affects multiple region endpoints. They see ~20% of requests fail for a short window. sample trace ids in ticket: trace=trc_9f3a, trc_9f3b. attaching repro and headers below. escalation opened with customer — they need a short-term mitigation while we triage.

Raj (Eng-SRE): thanks. can you paste the exact curl you used and a raw response body? also which model and region? any auth rotation going on?

Elaine (Support): curl they ran (sanitized):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood-us-west1.example.com/v1/generate
```
Response (502):
```
HTTP/2 502
content-type: application/json
{ "error": { "message": "Bad Gateway", "type": "proxy_error" } }
```
Region: us-west1, model: rdm-2.1-medium, customers says spike happened for ~3m then recovered. They also saw a 401 earlier for some tokens during same window.

DevBot: telemetry alert -> /v1/generate 5xx rate = 3.8% (5m), p95 latency +210ms, upstream resets increased from auth-service between 12:01-12:05 UTC. Top upstream status: auth-validate (502/503), model-backend healthy.

Maria (Infra): pulling edge logs now. early signs point to H2 conn pool saturation on the nginx -> envoy path. snippets: 
```
[2026-03-14T12:03:21Z] error: upstream reset: stream reset by peer, upstream=10.2.4.12:443, stream_id=45
[2026-03-14T12:03:22Z] warn: backend returned 502 due to no healthy upstreams
```
Looks like a burst of auth-validate calls caused connection pool pressure; when nginx/Envoy ran out of available streams it returned 502s to clients.

Raj (Eng-SRE): that matches similar flaps we saw last month. hypothesis: token rotation or an auth cache miss pattern spawns synchronous calls to auth-service for each inbound request -> auth-service transiently saturates -> upstream resets -> 502 cascades. Does the customer flow include a middleware that revalidates tokens on each request?

Elaine (Support): customer replied: they switched to a short TTL for dev tokens and had a background job rotating them during the window. so yes, likely token churn.

Oncall (Infra): immediate mitigations we can try:
- temporary: enable increased h2 concurrent stream limits and larger connection pool on nginx->envoy in us-west1 for the edge proxies (this reduces immediate 502s)
- short-term app-layer: add 1s token-validation cache on edge proxy so token bursts de-dup auth calls
- retries: add a conservative 1s retry with jitter on 502 for idempotent calls from edge (careful for non-idempotent).

Maria (Infra): I can push a hotfix config to increase `http2_max_concurrent_streams` and bump `upstream_keepalive_pool` in the us-west1 edge fleet. doing a gradual rollout to 10% first.

Raj (Eng-SRE): also add a circuit-breaker on auth-validate path: limit concurrent connections and fail fast to allow graceful fallback to 503->client instead of cascading 502. Filing a followup to track.

Elaine (Support): Customer accepted temporary retry suggestion and will pause token rotation for now. They've asked for RCA and permanent fix ETA.

DevBot: created event/alert: INC-3421 linked to thread (auto).

Raj (Eng-SRE): action items:
- Maria: hotfix config rollout (increase h2 streams & pool) -> in progress (10% canary)
- Infra/Oncall: add short token-validation cache at edge (config flag) -> quick patch scheduled for today
- Eng-Platform: plan for token grace-window + de-dupe of auth calls (next sprint)
- Support: keep customer updated, recommend pausing token rotation in prod until patch

Maria (Infra): canary deployed to 10% as of 12:15 UTC, monitoring for 5xx. will roll to 100% if 5xx drops below baseline.

Oncall (Infra): monitoring shows 5xx dropped from 3.8% -> 0.4% on canary nodes, no new upstream resets. rolling to 50% now.

Elaine (Support): customer confirmed error rate went down after we paused rotation. they're happy with mitigation; requested an incident summary and next steps.

Raj (Eng-SRE): for RCA draft: root cause = auth-token churn -> auth-validate service saw burst of requests -> h2 conn pool exhaustion between nginx and envoy -> upstream resets -> 502s surfaced to clients. Contributing factors: lack of short-lived caching and conservative h2 stream limits.

Maria (Infra): followups:
- PR to add configurable token-validation cache on edge (GH: redwood/edge#2154)
- PR to tune default h2 concurrency for proxies in auto-scale bursts
- add synthetic test in staging that simulates token rotation burst to catch regressions.

Elaine (Support): noted. i'll update the customer with the RCA summary and link to INC-3421. closing thread once the PRs are linked. :white_check_mark:

Raj (Eng-SRE): assigning INC-3421 to eng-infra and eng-sre. thanks team.

Oncall (Infra): last check at 12:28 UTC shows stable. marking monitoring as resolved.

(reacts: :eyes: by Raj, :thumbsup: by Elaine)
